content: Common a11y modal mistakes: focus not moved into dialog on open and not returned to trigger on close; CSS-only dimming doesn't block keyboard tabbing into background (need inert or aria-hidden via JS); duplicate/uncoordinated keydown listeners (one for focus trap, one for Escape) that both fire or leak after close; focusable-element list cached at mount instead of recomputed for dynamic content. Native <dialog>.showModal() gives focus trap + Escape + inert-like behavior for free and is now the preferred approach over hand-rolled traps.
